snapshot.text: Compulsory health insurance through the Health Insurance Fund. The ministry changed hands in mid-2026, and the country launched its first WHO country cooperation strategy for 2026–2030.

priorities.title: WHO cooperation strategy 2026–2030
priorities.text: North Macedonia's first WHO country cooperation strategy sets shared priorities with a whole-of-government approach.

priorities.title: Organ donation campaign
priorities.text: The health ministry reports encouraging early results from an organ donation campaign.
